notes.title: Noble Duty Patch Update 9/25
notes.notes:
Game will play even if window is inactive.
Fixed Gameplay Message for Controller/Keyboard. It will flip sides if the game cursor is beneath it now.
Fixed a specific bug where if you have Mouse + Keyboard/Controller on and when you hover over the Weapon Type in Character Menu, it will be stuck. If you see this bug, please move your mouse around to reset the cursor.
Minor Grammar Updates


Thank you for playing the game!

notes.title: Update September 15th
notes.notes:
Chapter 3 had General Reinforcements with redundant Charisma Skills. This is cleaned up.
Switched Hydra Class with the skill "Mighty Attack" to "Magic Attack." They use magic attack so this was a mistake.
In Chapter 5, if you visit the house with the "incorrect unit," it would lock out the correct unit. This is now fixed.


Thank you again for your patience. If there are any issues, please let me know and I will do what I can to fix these bugs.

notes.title: Chapter 4 and 12 Music Bug Fix
notes.notes: If you save during the battle prep menu, start the map, then load your save file it would turn off the music. This is now fixed so music will always play after loading your save file.

notes.title: Quick Bug Fix With Formation
notes.notes:
There was a game crash if you use the Formation Command in the Base Menu and move characters in a specific way. This mechanic does not do anything useful for gameplay so it is removed. This will not change the experience playing the game. You can still reposition units during the battle prep menu right before the chapter begins.

With each update, the Game Config might reset. Please just double check it if anything is changed. Thank you for your time and patience.
